title: Inequalities (half-planes)
summary:
To graph a *half-plane* write the separating line in the form and construct it with

`` ` ` ` (x,y) ax + by + c = 0 inverse:true ` ` y = 2x + 3 2x - 1y + 3 = 0 x = 3 1x + 0y - 3 = 0 2x - y + 3 = 0` (greater than form hence do add "inverse: true") - red region.
